revision_note: v1 had 2 false positives (DEFECT-001, DEFECT-002) caused by client-side parser extraction errors, not by server-side bugs. v2 re-verifies each finding with raw output and shape inspection.
scope: arif-fazil.com site + HERMES MCP + federation organs

defects_revalidated.original_claim: hermes_retrieve tool returns empty contents for 31/31 URIs
defects_revalidated.verification_v2: Raw response: {"tool":"hermes_retrieve","status":"OK","result":{"found":true,"resource_uri":"hermes://canon/rasa","content":"# RASA ..."}} — parsed with juster `j.get('contents',[])` returns []. Correct key is `result.content` (singular string) NOT `contents` (array).
defects_revalidated.conclusion: Tool works correctly. Client extraction logic was wrong.
defects_revalidated.evidence: Raw output shows real content: '# RASA — Preserving the Remainder (hermes://canon/rasa, v1.1.0) ...'. hermes_retrieve serves all31 resources as advertised.

defects_revalidated.original_claim: hermes_scar_wisdom returns 0 scars for all queries
defects_revalidated.verification_v2: Raw response with query 'scars about hermes arif audit deploy prompt grounding fail': returns 'SCAR CONTEXT (2): • SCAR-2026-09-04-003-iarif-zen-cascade • SCAR-LEDGER-HUMAN-ARIF-FAZIL-2026-09-23' + 3 EUREKA CONTEXT entries. The fields are `should_cont[e]have_injected_scars` and `would_have_injected_chars`, NOT direct `scars` array.
defects_revalidated.conclusion: Tool works correctly. Specific keyword queries DO surface scars + eurekas + shadow log path. Generic queries correctly return 'no scar matched'.
defects_revalidated.evidence: Real response: 'SCAR CONTEXT (2): • SCAR-2026-09-04-003-iarif-zen-cascade ... → /root/AAA/scars/SCAR-2026-09-04-003-iarif-zen-cascade.md ... EUREKA CONTEXT (3): • EUREKA-ARIF-SALAM-IRFAN-LOOP-2026-09-23 ... shadow_log /root/.hermes/runtime/shadow-injector.log'

defects_revalidated.claim: mcp.arif-fazil.com/mcp does not emit mcp-session-id header on initialize
defects_revalidated.verification: Confirmed. But: ping + tools/list both work WITHOUT session header — kernel is stateless by design (streamable-HTTP stateless mode, see 2026-07-28 protocol).
defects_revalidated.conclusion: Not a defect. mcp.arif-fazil.com is a stateless gateway (canonical MCP 2025-11-25 supports both stateful and stateless). Document the endpoint mode in .well-known/mcp.json for clarity.
defects_revalidated.evidence: POST /mcp initialize returns 200 bytes=3126 with x-arifOS hostname header but no mcp-session-id. tools/list works immediately. This is consistent with stateless streamable-HTTP.

defects_revalidated.claim: Hidden endpoints return 200 with empty body
defects_revalidated.conclusion: Real defect — Caddy is forwarding routes but the upstream has no handlers. Spurious 200s.
defects_revalidated.fix_path: Either remove the routes from Caddy, OR implement handlers with actual responses.
